descriptor.description: List documents published in the official BOE gazette on a date.
descriptor.name: es_browse_gazette

dataset_note.default: BOE consolidated legislation is reached by BOE id / ELI (es_get_act, es_get_text) or by browsing the daily gazette (es_browse_gazette). The BOE open-data keyword-search endpoint is unavailable (server-side error), so this connector offers no free-text search.

items.description: One document published in a daily BOE gazette.

descriptor.description:
Declare what this connector covers, how it is sourced, and what it does NOT cover.

Call this before telling a user that the law "does not contain" something, and whenever
a search comes back empty: the absence may be a gap in this connector rather than in the
law. Every gap carries a fallback saying where to look instead.

Returns:
    ``Coverage`` with families, an as-of note, and a non-empty list of known gaps.
descriptor.name: es_coverage

outputSchema.description: What this connector covers, how it is sourced, and what it does not cover.

as_of_note.description: States what the dates mean, and what they do not promise.

items.description: One data family this connector exposes.

captured_at.description: Date this family was last captured (ISO). None when queried live.

live.description: True when queried live instead of from a snapshot.

source.description: Official source the data comes from.

tool.description: Tool or tools that reach this family.

known_gaps.description: Never empty. An empty list would mean 'not checked', not 'no gaps'.

items.description: A known, named hole in this connector's coverage - plus the way around it.

family.description: Which family the gap belongs to.

missing.description: What is NOT available through this connector.

descriptor.description: Fetch consolidated-law metadata from BOE by id.
descriptor.name: es_get_act

dataset_note.default: BOE consolidated legislation is reached by BOE id / ELI (es_get_act, es_get_text) or by browsing the daily gazette (es_browse_gazette). The BOE open-data keyword-search endpoint is unavailable (server-side error), so this connector offers no free-text search.

descriptor.description: Resolve an AEPD expediente number to its resolution and full-text PDF permalink.

expediente.description:
the AEPD procedure number, e.g. ``"PS-00615-2025"`` (PS = sanciones,
PD = derechos, AI = actuaciones de investigacion).

descriptor.name: es_get_aepd_resolution

outputSchema.description: One AEPD resolution teaser (search hit or es_get_aepd_resolution result).

dataset_note.default: AEPD resolutions are reached by full-text/date search (es_search_aepd_resolutions) or by expediente number (es_get_aepd_resolution, e.g. 'PS-00615-2025'). Source: www.aepd.es/informes-y-resoluciones/resoluciones (~46,800 resolutions). The full text is the linked PDF (pdf_url); this connector returns the teaser + permalink, not the PDF body.

descriptor.description: Fetch a Tribunal Constitucional ruling (Sentencia/Auto/Declaracion) by internal id.

resolution_id.description:
the internal Sistema HJ sequential id (e.g. ``"6670"`` for STC 31/2010).
Get this id either from ``es_search_constitutional`` or from a hyperlink inside
another ruling's text (``.../Resolucion/Show/{id}``).

descriptor.name: es_get_constitutional_ruling

outputSchema.description: A Tribunal Constitucional resolution (Sentencia / Auto / Declaracion).

dataset_note.default: Tribunal Constitucional rulings are reached by internal resolution id (es_get_constitutional_ruling) or by human citation number+year (es_search_constitutional, e.g. numero=31, anno=2010 for 'STC 31/2010'). Source: hj.tribunalconstitucional.es (Sistema HJ / Buscador de jurisprudencia constitucional), server-rendered HTML, no free-text full-content search.

descriptor.description: List the block index (articles, titles) of a consolidated law.
descriptor.name: es_get_index

items.description: One block in a law's text index.

dataset_note.default: BOE consolidated legislation is reached by BOE id / ELI (es_get_act, es_get_text) or by browsing the daily gazette (es_browse_gazette). The BOE open-data keyword-search endpoint is unavailable (server-side error), so this connector offers no free-text search.

descriptor.description: Fetch a full DGT tax ruling by its official number.
descriptor.name: es_get_tax_ruling

dataset_note.default: DGT consultas tributarias are reached by official number (es_get_tax_ruling, e.g. 'V0001-25') or by full-text/date search (es_search_tax_rulings). Source: petete.tributos.hacienda.gob.es (Doctrina Tributaria, ~69,500 consultas vinculantes + ~19,700 consultas generales). Tax rulings have no ELI/ECLI; the official NUM-CONSULTA is the durable identifier.

descriptor.description: Fetch one TEAC criterio (with the full resolution text) by its DYCTEA id.
descriptor.name: es_get_teac_criterio

dataset_note.default: TEAC doctrine (criterios) is reached by RG claim-number segments and/or a resolution-date range (es_search_teac_doctrine) and opened by criterio id (es_get_teac_criterio, e.g. '00/07082/2025/00/0/1'). Source: DYCTEA (serviciostelematicosext.hacienda.gob.es/TEAC/DYCTEA, ~6,500 criterios). The portal accepts free-text-looking parameters but silently ignores them, so this connector offers no full-text search on TEAC.

descriptor.description: Fetch the consolidated text (XML) of a law, whole or by block.

block_id.description:
optional block id from ``es_get_index`` (e.g. ``"a1"`` for Articulo 1).
Omit for the full consolidated text (can be large).

descriptor.name: es_get_text
